d: Hey guys! I was in Kerala during Christmas and got to shoot this video with my sister Vandana. We grew up learning music together but don't get to sing together as much these days, so this was such a lovely opportunity. "Pallivalu Bhadravattakam" is a folk song from Kerala and this song's vibe inspired Shankar and I to write our own original lyrics and English tune. So many amazing people were part of this video!
